LLM auditresponse for PKGBUILD:
<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
This PKGBUILD is a standard, straightforward package definition for a Waybar plugin written in Rust. The `source` array fetches a tarball directly from the package's declared GitHub upstream (`https://github.com/mryll/tickerbar/archive/refs/tags/v$pkgver.tar.gz`), which is expected and appropriate behavior. A sha256sum is provided (not SKIP), and there is no top-level code execution, no command substitutions, no obfuscation, and no network requests to unexpected hosts. The `pkgver()` is static (not defined as a function), so no dynamic version fetching occurs. This is a typical AUR package with no supply chain attack indicators.
</details>
<evidence>
